Batch: MiTeC Paradox Data Editor bundled BDE publisher deployment follow-up

ObservedClaims: Embarcadero describes BDE as deprecated and says it will not be enhanced; it advises against new development and recommends migration to FireDAC.
Embarcadero's BDE page points to the DEPLOY document for specific BDE redistribution rights and limitations.

Embarcadero warns that improper installation of BDE or BDE subsets can cause other BDE-based applications to fail and says registry-based configuration requires correct installation and deletion entries.

The software-license guidance says the DEPLOY document in the product installation covers BDE distribution and that third-party component redistribution rights remain governed by the supplying vendor.
PublisherDocumentation.Limits: These RAD Studio documents explain where version-specific deployment rights are recorded and warn about shared BDE installation effects. They do not provide the DEPLOY/README terms for retained BDE 5.1.1.1 or grant redistribution of the copy bundled with MiTeC Paradox Data Editor.

DirectPageAccess.Result: HTTP 403 Forbidden; search-indexed official page content was reviewed; no access-control workaround attempted
HTTP 403 Forbidden; search-indexed official page content was reviewed; no access-control workaround attempted

Disposition.Resolved: Official current guidance confirms BDE is deprecated, highlights compatibility risks from incorrect/shared installation, and identifies version-specific DEPLOY/README as the source of precise redistribution rules.
Disposition.Partial: The exact applicable BDE 5.1.1.1 DEPLOY/README, MiTeC's right to bundle it, local user entitlement, and current Windows compatibility remain unknown.
RemainingBlockers: Do not register or install BDE on the host. Incorrect shared BDE setup can break existing applications and modify machine registry configuration.
Obtain the applicable BDE 5.1.1.1 DEPLOY/README and MiTeC bundle terms from an authorized source before considering distribution or activation.
Keep provider/bitness compatibility, aliases, install/repeat/uninstall recovery and synthetic Paradox database acceptance deferred until licensing and an isolated BDE fixture are available.
Disposition.EstimateReason: Publisher deployment guidance narrows the licensing and coexistence evidence required but provides no version-specific rights for the retained bundle; no whole outcome or acceptance gate closed.
